blocks.x: U.S. Soldiers assigned to U.S. Army Southern European Task Force, Africa (SETAF-AF), participate in the 'Lion’s Legacy: Ready and Resilient' games at Caserma Del Din, Italy, Mar. 7, 2025. SETAF-AF’s exercises and events enhance operational readiness by fostering teamwork, problem-solving and resilience under pressure. Lion’s Legacy is designed to enhance unit cohesion and teamwork through a series of physical changes. (U.S. Army video by Pfc. Olivia Ward) Music by BackGroundMusicLab from Pixabay https://pixabay.com/music/upbeat-extreme-sports-174640/
